intended_use: Deterministic concurrency for consumption and lifecycle mutation.
expected: Concurrent attempts to consume one permit yield exactly one success; concurrent attempts to apply the same transition yield one applied mutation and deterministic already-applied repeats without corrupting state.
setup: A SessionManager and PermitRegistry guarded by a single std::mutex; concurrent threads attempt one-permit consumption and the same transition on a shared live session.
observed: Internal worker CTest run (sandbox): the 5 unit case IDs CON-01, CON-02, CON-03, CON-04, CON-05 and the 1 integration test Integration.IndependentControllerScopes all passed (part of T4 107/107 unit and T5 4/4 integration; 0 failures). Exactly one success / one applied mutation with deterministic already-applied repeats and no state corruption.
limitation: Internal worker evidence only; concurrency is proven by deterministic stress under a coarse-grained mutex, not by a race detector (ThreadSanitizer remains pending_protected_sanitizer_verification).
